text:
Raj: Heads-up — the new authz-graph shim is causing weird quota splits in the dashboard for hybrid keys. Anyone else see project attribution disappearing after fallback?
Sasha: yup saw it on prod metrics, spikes at 03:14 UTC :grimace:
Maya: I think it's the fallback path that rewrites origin -> anonymous when the principal can't be mapped. falling back to proxy_identity.
Tom: Can you paste the sample header we saw? I want to reproduce locally.
Maya: here's the failing header: ```Authorization: Bearer tkn_abc123; X-Origin-Project: 42; X-Proxy-Origin: org:xyz``` It ends up hitting the shim, shim returns `effective_project=null`.
Raj: Right — shim returns null and then routing chooses default quota bucket `shared:catchall` which hides attribution in console.
Li: This matters for committed customers. We lose billing attribution and SLA dashboards.
Sasha: Proposal: make shim emit a `fallback_reason` tag and preserve original origin in telemetry. Then console can show fallback rows.
Tom: +1 — also add a counter metric `shim.fallback_count{reason="unmapped-principal"}`
eng-bot: New alert created: `authz-shim-fallback` triggered 3 times in last 5m - https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/234
Maya: For rollout: feature-flag `authz_shim_preserve_origin` default off; turn on in canary orgs, 24h, then enable globally.
Raj: UX ask: console should not drop the project column when fallback happens; instead show `project: unknown (shim fallback)` and link to trace.
Li: Telemetry team — add a dashboard tile: counts by `fallback_reason` + top offending service tokens.
Sasha: One more internal API debate: should shim set `effective_org` from proxy token claims or require explicit exchange call? I vote explicit exchange.
Tom: Explicit exchange safer, but adds latency for hot paths. Could be conditional: if token TTL > 5m, do exchange async and mark as `pending_exchange`.
Maya: Async exchange means some requests will still route to fallback; need consistent behavior for quota. Maybe conservative routing until exchange completes.
Raj: Can we implement a temporary sticky mapping: if exchange resolves within 10s, backfill metrics and apply delta to quota usage? risk of double-counting.
Li: Backfilling is tricky for billing. We should instead emit compensating event `quota_correction` with negative/positive values; billing can ingest.
Sasha: OK we'll draft an ADR for shim contract + telemetry schema. I'll start and ping product for console label copy.
Tom: I can prototype the metric names and a small middleware to emit `fallback_reason` and `original_origin` headers.
eng-bot: Deploy queued: authz-shim v0.3.2 to canary (canary flag: authz-shim-preserve-origin) — initiated by Maya
ops-bot: Canary env health: 200/200 checks passing, CPU 28%, no fallback alerts for canary orgs yet :thumbsup:
Raj: Great — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to approve global rollout if canary stable.
Maya: added to calendar. Thanks all :pray:
